reasoning_chain: Observed high error rates on edges checkoutservice->currencyservice (58.8%) and frontend->checkoutservice (58.8%).
checkoutservice itself reports 65.4% errors in its own metrics, while its p95 latency (46.25ms) is modest and CPU usage is far from its limit.
All downstream services called by checkoutservice (currencyservice, productcatalogservice, shippingservice, emailservice, paymentservice) show 0% errors and low latency, indicating they are healthy.
Errors converge on checkoutservice as the caller, matching the pattern where a radiating slow/error edge points to the root cause.
Therefore the fault originates in checkoutservice, propagating to frontend which sees the same error rate.
evidence: CPU usage of checkoutservice not near limit

proposed_actions.rationale: Restarting the pod will clear any hidden state or resource leak causing the high error rate while the service itself shows no CPU pressure.
Increasing CPU limits gives headroom in case the errors are due to occasional CPU throttling not reflected in current usage metrics.
